title: 红花向着光
goal: 把叶簇笔触迁移到花丛并保留亮部
scene: Small sunny patch of red flowers growing naturally outdoors, THREE flower groups at staggered heights, broad pale-pink flower masses with selective red short dabs on lower edges, muted-teal leaves and dark-olive small bases, pale gray-beige ground. Open white paper all around. No vase or pot, no petal microdetail. More grouped brushwork than beginner but still simple.
decision: 自行安排高低；用浅粉底与红色短笔触迁移叶簇方法
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE square standalone original S002 sunlit brushstroke landscape artwork on white marker paper. Transparent oil/alcohol student-marker aesthetic, broad readable color masses and selective natural short plant strokes, sunny light and shadow groups, airy white paper, NO thick black outlines, NO cute faces. No printed words, numbers, panels, color swatches, watermarks or tools. Use only stated approximate hue families, slight same-marker overlap allowed; no smooth digital gradients, opaque impasto or pale strokes painted over dark. Reserve white shapes BEFORE color. No unnecessary microdetail or dense all-over texture. Narrow natural white margins. Composition must be distinct from other scenes. Intended for 16.5cm square marker paper. Stage: D2 specialized control, ONE primary skill, sparse simple scene. review_note: 当前成品笔触与枝叶比专项课目标偏密；正式D2教案需减至少量植物组、减少细节，或分次练习。
